blocks.text: BYD Cebu Group is expanding its presence in southern Cebu with the opening of BYD Cebu South at Gridlane Plaza in Tunghaan, Minglanilla, on November 24, marking its sixth dealer facility in the province. The new dealership brings BYD’s electric and new energy vehicle offerings closer to motorists in southern Cebu while expanding access to vehicle sales, maintenance, spare parts, and charging facilities. The opening was attended by representatives from BYD Philippines, ACMobility, local government officials, business partners, and members of the media.
